## The five parts

Over one semester you build a complete content analysis from scratch, moving from qualitative immersion through quantitative testing, using real media data.

::: {.v2v-arc}
::: {.v2v-phase}
[Foundation]{.v2v-phase-name}
[Ch 1 to 3]{.v2v-phase-meta}
:::
::: {.v2v-phase}
[Planning]{.v2v-phase-name}
[Ch 4 to 6]{.v2v-phase-meta}
:::
::: {.v2v-phase}
[Operationalization]{.v2v-phase-name}
[Ch 7 to 9]{.v2v-phase-meta}
:::
::: {.v2v-phase}
[Execution]{.v2v-phase-name}
[Ch 10 to 12]{.v2v-phase-meta}
:::
::: {.v2v-phase}
[Inference & Publication]{.v2v-phase-name}
[Ch 13 to 14]{.v2v-phase-meta}
:::
:::

| Part | Chapters | Focus |
|------|----------|-------|
| **I: Foundation** | 1 to 3 | Storytelling as science, open tools, epistemology |
| **II: Planning** | 4 to 6 | Literature, theory, the research prospectus |
| **III: Operationalization** | 7 to 9 | Qualitative immersion, codebook, data collection |
| **IV: Execution** | 10 to 12 | Sampling, data wrangling, visualization |
| **V: Inference and Publication** | 13 to 14 | Statistical inference, the one-click report |

## The ecosystem

Four tools work together throughout the course. Each serves a distinct role, and they all live inside VS Code or link out from it.

| Tool | What it does | When you use it |
|------|-------------|-----------------|
| [**Course Workspace**](workspace.qmd) | VS Code workspace for journals, notes, and project files | Every week, as your personal research archive |
| **v2v R package** | Sets up your environment, checks that everything works, and provides the practice corpus | Installed in Week 2, used through the applied weeks |
| [**Textbook**](https://aura-lab.siue.edu/v2v/) | *Vibes to Variables* (3rd Edition, 14 chapters) | Every week, for the conceptual foundation of each part |
| **This website (V2V Hub)** | Syllabus, schedule, assignments, the [R Workbook](workbook/index.qmd), and setup guides | Whenever you need to know what is due or how to do something |
